evidence.title: French beans export contract pricing in Machakos / Yatta
evidence.claim: Export packhouses offer contract pricing of 95-120 KES/kg for extra-fine French beans meeting GlobalGAP compliance.
evidence.detail: Fixed-price contract agreements protect growers against local market price collapses, but non-compliant batches with MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) exceedances are rejected at the packhouse gate without compensation.
quality_flags: Requires strict spray diary record-keeping and GlobalGAP certification.

evidence.title: Yatta canal water rotational rationing
evidence.claim: Canal maintenance and low river intake cause 2-day-per-week water shutdowns during dry periods.
evidence.detail: Growers reliant exclusively on direct canal tapping without buffer storage suffer blossom drop and pod curvature, reducing export grade pack-out from 80% to below 45%.
quality_flags: Buffer water pan required for continuous drip.

conflicts.explanation: Market opportunity is viable, but water abstraction quotas or seasonal rationing contradict open-field irrigation without permitted reservoir storage.

missing_information: Confirm the source dates and grading methodology for wholesale price claims.
Verify farm-specific water abstraction quotas and on-farm buffer storage capacity.
Obtain written offtake terms or binding purchase agreements before transplanting.
next_actions: Inspect the cited source URLs and verify date and grade relevance to Kirinyaga.
Obtain current local supplier quotations for drip irrigation and certified seed.
Re-run the investigation once farm-specific cost and water permits are established.

financial_metrics.sensitivity_notes: Export packhouse contract guarantees 105 KES/kg, insulating farmer from local price volatility. However, Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) violations result in total rejection of consignments without payment. risk_matrix.title: Export Packhouse MRL Rejection Penalty
risk_matrix.impact: Packhouses enforce zero-tolerance on EU Maximum Residue Limits; contaminated shipments face 100% loss.
risk_matrix.mitigation: Require contract with certified exporter providing agronomist-supervised spray records and GlobalGAP certification.

risk_matrix.title: Yatta Canal Rotational Water Rationing
risk_matrix.impact: Canal intake maintenance shuts off water 2 days per week, causing pod curvature and dropping export packout from 80% to under 45%.
risk_matrix.mitigation: Mandate installation of a 100m³ plastic-lined buffer water pan before loan disbursement.

risk_matrix.title: Contradiction in pricing_vs_water_quota

risk_matrix.mitigation: Require human field verification and signed purchase orders before capital commitment.
